description_en: Queries all certificates that are available for a domain name. This operation does not query the certificate that is currently in use
description_zh: 查询用户适用于当前域名的所有证书信息，而非当前使用的证书
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-certs --resource-group-id default --domain www.aliyun.com --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCerts

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS instance belongs in Resource Management. If you leave this parameter empty, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of your website.

A website forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

CertIdentifier.description_en: The global certificate ID. The value is a string that consists of the certificate ID and the region ID, separated by a hyphen (-). For example, if the certificate ID is \`123\` and the region is \`cn-hangzhou\`, the value of \`CertIdentifier\` is \`123-cn-hangzhou\`

Common.description_en: The domain name that is associated with the certificate

DomainRelated.description_en:
Indicates whether the certificate is associated with the domain name. Valid values:

true: The certificate is associated with the domain name.

false: The certificate is not associated with the domain name
DomainRelated.description_zh:
证书是否关联域名。取值：
true：已关联
false：未关联

EndDate.description_en: The expiration date of the certificate. The value is a string
EndDate.description_zh: 证书到期日期。字符串格式

Issuer.description_en: The certification authority (CA) that issued the certificate

StartDate.description_en: The issuance date of the certificate. The value is a string
StartDate.description_zh: 证书签发日期。字符串格式
